name: ai-chat-next
title: AI chat routes (Next.js)
description: lib/assistant.ts and the app/api/chat routes: the ai-chat block's assistant, the tools it may call, and the routes that send a message, resume its stream and stop it.
docs: Needs the ai-chat and streams blocks (`npx better-supabase add ai-chat`), `lib/supabase/blocks.generated.ts` from `npx better-supabase gen`, and an AI Gateway key. Add the blocks' tools in `assistantTools`. Pair it with the `use-ai-chat` hooks on the client. See https://bettersupabase.com/docs/ai-sdk/chat.
